|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Specter Of The Supreme Leader (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V7-D-specterofthesupremeleader-2018-07-09.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V7-D-specterofthesupremeleader-2018-07-09-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V7-D-specterofthesupremeleader-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V7-D-specterofthesupremeleader-2018-07-09-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V7-D-specterofthesupremeleader-2018-07-09.gif]], 9 July 2018).
* '''Original''' ([[Specter Of The Supreme Leader]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-specterofthesupremel022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/specterofthesupremeleader.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Dark/large/specterofthesupremeleader.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•You Want This, Don’t You?”. Text: “Deploy on table. The Phantom Menace is canceled. You lose no Force to Kylo Ren or Kylo Ren's Lightsaber. If Kylo (or Kylo Ren's Lightsaber) just lost, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to take that card into hand. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 9 July 2018<ref name="img-specterofthesupremel6d7b3a4">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/specterofthesupremeleader.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6d7b3a40f529171f7399cff382887d6260118998 commit 6d7b3a4] (9 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Dark/large/specterofthesupremeleader.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
